entities.name: Heiko
entities.description: Norika's younger cousin, who flees her Imperial family and joins the Uprisers in Sokenzanshi, where she falls in love with Chiye.

entities.name: Norika Yamazaki
entities.description: Heiko's elder cousin, injured by a kami attack as a child, who becomes an Imperial commander in Sokenzanshi with augments laid into her skin.

entities.name: Chiye
entities.description: A cook and Upriser with three steam-jet teapots who sponsors Heiko and loves her.

entities.name: Risona
entities.description: The tall, grave leader of the Uprisers in Sokenzanshi.

entities.name: Naomi
entities.description: An Imperial advisor and Norika's mentor, who sends her to command in Sokenzanshi.

entities.name: The Emperor of Kamigawa
entities.description: The ruler who vanished and whose pilgrims once petitioned Eiganjo.

entities.name: Faceless kami
entities.description: A faceless kami in ghostly robes with a sword through its body that emerged from a merge and swept a vortex through Norika.

entities.name: Uprisers
entities.description: Rebels in Sokenzanshi who feed, house and school displaced people.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The ruling authority of Kamigawa whose mechs and enforcers suppress unauthorized tech and food distribution.

entities.name: Yamazaki household
entities.description: The Imperial family that raised Norika and Heiko.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: The Imperial city and its temple gardens.

entities.name: Sokenzanshi
entities.description: A cold mountain city where the Uprisers hold sway.

entities.name: Merge
entities.description: A shimmering opening to the spirit realm in the Eiganjo gardens that disgorged the kami that attacked Norika.

entities.name: Neuroprosthesis
entities.description: Imperial prosthetics that grew into Norika's body after her injury, shown as turquoise designs on her skin.

events.summary: As children, Norika and Heiko sneak to the tea garden to see a merge, and a faceless kami emerges and attacks.
events.quote: Something is shouldering its way through the gap.

events.summary: Norika throws herself between the kami and Heiko and is struck by a beam of pain, leaving her paralyzed for years.
Ten years later, Heiko arrives alone in Sokenzanshi, having fled her family on her eighteenth birthday.
events.quote: Serves her right for fleeing her family the moment her eighteenth birthday arrived.

events.summary: Heiko meets Chiye at a soup line, and Imperial mechs break up the unauthorized assembly as Uprisers hurl snowballs.
Chiye brings Heiko to Risona, who agrees to accept her with Chiye's sponsorship.
Norika's recovery and rise, from the Imperial medics to chief handler of the merge in Eiganjo, culminating in Naomi sending her to command in Sokenzanshi.
events.quote: "The bandit problem in Sokenzanshi has gotten out of hand. I need you to take command there."

events.summary: Heiko and Chiye rob an Imperial provisions train and are caught by enforcers.
events.quote: Two Imperial enforcers pull them out of the car and throw them to the ground

events.summary: Heiko recognizes the commander as her cousin Norika from her secret finger-tapping signal.
events.quote: Almost imperceptibly, the commander is tapping the backs of two fingers against her armored leg.

events.summary: Norika dismisses the enforcers, frees the prisoners and proposes an opportunity to fix the food crisis.
Heiko confesses she loves Chiye as she sends them to warn Risona.
events.quote: "I love you, now get out of here .

events.summary: Heiko and Norika fight on the tracks and Norika reveals she came to forgive her.
events.quote: "I didn't come here to make you pay. I came here to forgive you."

events.summary: Heiko shows Norika the Uprisers' charity work as she pretends to be Norika's prisoner.
events.quote: The Uprisers keep them heated, manage water and power.

events.summary: Risona holds an axe to Norika's throat, and Norika agrees to leave the storehouse contents and stop the taxes.
Heiko and Norika part, unsure if they are allies, and clasp hands.
events.quote: "But I don't yet know if we're allies."

relations.note: Heiko tells Chiye she loves her and Chiye says it back
relations.quote: Now, I haven't told her yet, but I love her, too.
her mentor summoned her to the strategy room
it will not quell the revolt.
"Actually, she's acting like an Upriser," Chiye interjects.
The commander towers over them in white armor edged with gold.

relations.note: tentative cooperation, unsure if they are allies
